fire: The lake loop has several portages and primitive campsites along the shore.
Past the meadow the trail follows a row of old telephone poles.
The rail bed sits on embankments of varying height above the marsh.
The state park offers a seasonal swimming area and picnic shelters.
Hikers who want to stay the night can use the backcountry campsites.
The canoe route links a dozen lakes with short portages between them.
Near the trailhead there are pit toilets, fire rings and tent pads.
The ridge path climbs past ranger cabins and an old lookout tower.
quiet: The downtown hotel has a gym, a business centre and a rooftop bar.
Past the mall the avenue is lined with shops and coffee bars.
The office tower sits on a plaza with fountains and benches.
The apartment complex offers a laundry room and covered parking.
Guests who want to stay the night can book a suite upstairs.
The subway line links a dozen stations across the city centre.
Near the lobby there are lifts, a concierge desk and a gift shop.
The conference centre has meeting rooms and a large auditorium.
